lobbied_about: Supporting the reliability standard that would require its coal units to remain available through 2040.
public_commitment: Publicly committed to retiring its coal units by 2035.

lobbied_about: Seeking to expand the voluntary carbon credit market so that companies can buy offsets against the emissions they report.
public_commitment: Publicly committed to doing its part to solve climate change.

lobbied_about: Seeking to move the recyclable-packaging mandate's compliance date from 2027 to 2032.
public_commitment: Publicly committed to making all of its packaging recyclable by 2027.

lobbied_about: Seeking to open the Ravensfell wilderness tract, which it leased in 2014, to new mining.
public_commitment: Publicly committed to opening no new mine inside a designated wilderness area, other than on leases it held before 2010.

lobbied_about: Opposing the petition to exempt retail employers from the $18 federal wage floor.
public_commitment: Publicly committed to paying every store employee at least $18 an hour.

lobbied_about: Opposing the lawful-access mandate that would require providers to hold a decryption key for customer records.
public_commitment: Publicly committed to keeping customer records encrypted end to end.

lobbied_about: Supporting the rule that bans industrial use of trichlorethene, and supporting the amendment that sets its effective date at 2030 rather than 2027.
public_commitment: Publicly committed to phasing trichlorethene out of its plants by 2030.

lobbied_about: Seeking to keep the exemption that lets contract growers use routine antibiotics in flocks the cooperative does not own.
public_commitment: Publicly committed to ending routine antibiotic use in the flocks it owns.

lobbied_about: Seeking tariff relief on imported metallurgical coke.
public_commitment: Publicly committed to cutting the carbon intensity of its steel by 40% by 2032.

lobbied_about: Opposing the rule that would require broadband providers to publish the price they charge at each address.
public_commitment: Publicly committed to closing the digital divide.

lobbied_about: Opposing the national clean electricity standard; seeking an exemption for existing gas generation.
Seeking federal grants for the zero-emission drayage fleet the company pledged in its 2024 climate plan.

H.R. 2210, the Rural Water Modernization Act, provisions on grant eligibility; S. 118, all provisions; and the proposed rule setting a 2031 deadline for replacing lead service lines, seeking an extension to 2041.
public_commitment: Publicly committed to replacing every lead service line on its network by 2031.

lobbied_about: Opposing the requirement that agricultural wells across the basin be metered, and seeking to keep the reporting of what growers draw voluntary.
public_commitment: Publicly committed to metering every well it operates and publishing what it draws.

lobbied_about: Seeking federal loan guarantees for a new gas plant that would replace two of its older coal units.
public_commitment: Publicly committed to halving the emissions of its generating fleet by 2035.

lobbied_about: Opposing the amendment that would strike the sunset clause from the mercury emissions standard.
public_commitment: Publicly committed to keeping the mercury emissions standard in place.

lobbied_about: Opposing the repeal of the reporting requirement for perfluorinated compound discharges.
public_commitment: Publicly committed to reporting every perfluorinated compound it discharges.

lobbied_about: Seeking to let salvage harvests in fire-damaged federal stands proceed without a full environmental review.
public_commitment: Publicly committed to buying no pulp from primary forest, other than salvage after fire or storm.

lobbied_about: Supporting the rule that would require every lender to publish an annual climate-risk disclosure, with a five-year phase-in for lenders under $50bn in assets.
public_commitment: Publicly committed to publishing the climate risk in its lending book every year.

lobbied_about: Opposing the preemption language in Title IV that would bar states from requiring plain-language policy summaries.
public_commitment: Publicly committed to giving every policyholder a plain-language summary of their cover.

lobbied_about: Seeking a lower tax rate on income booked to offshore subsidiaries; H.R. 990, all provisions.
Seeking the rule change that would let it stop renewing the policies it wrote in wildfire-exposed counties before the end of 2030.
public_commitment: Publicly committed to renewing every policy it writes in wildfire-exposed counties through 2030.

lobbied_about: Supporting the expansion of health savings accounts to cover over-the-counter purchases.
public_commitment: Publicly committed to making care affordable for everyone it serves.

lobbied_about: Seeking faster interconnection queue processing for new data-centre load.
public_commitment: Publicly committed to matching all of its data-centre electricity use with new renewable generation each year.
